summary: BICSI recommends that the FCC require E‑Rate consultants who design or specify ICT infrastructure to hold a current BICSI RCDD credential, arguing this would improve technical competency and program integrity. The comment argues that E‑Rate should require the BICSI RCDD credential for ICT infrastructure design to protect federal investments and ensure high‑quality, resilient networks. BICSI proposes that the FCC mandate that any E‑Rate consultant who designs or specifies ICT infrastructure must hold a current BICSI Registered Communications Distribution Designer (RCDD) credential, arguing this will improve design quality and protect program integrity. BICSI proposes that any E‑Rate consultant who designs or approves ICT infrastructure must hold a current BICSI RCDD credential, arguing it improves program integrity and ensures professional competency. No policy claims identified in the provided text.
